NATIONAL COLLEGE OF EDUCATION ESTABLISHED FOR THE STUDENTS OF TECHNOLOGYSTREAM

IN terms of the powers vested in me under Section 2(1)(a) of the Colleges of Education Act, No. 30 of 1986 and pursuantto the cabinet approval granted on 18.01.2017 for the Cabinet Memorandum No. 2016/ED/E/33 dated 26.09.2016 and inaccordance with the Plan of the Surveyor General bearing the Advance Tracing No. KU/KPW/2016/635 dated 23.08.2016and in terms of the notice on the Acceptance of Possession No. DIVKW/LND/ACQLA/4-D/38, I, declare that the newNational College of Education established in the land consisting of three plots to the extent of 15 Acres, 0 Rood, and15.44 Perches belonging to the Ministry of Education situated in Poogalla and Narangalla villages of the NarangallaGrama Niladhari Division to be named as The National College of Education on Technology - Kuliyapitiya.
